title: Logarithmic space is contained in polynomial space
statement: Every binary language decidable by a finite Turing machine using at most $c(\log_2 n+1)$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$, for some natural number $c$, belongs to the class of languages decidable using at most $c'(n^{c'}+1)$ work-tape cells for some natural number $c'.$
